description: This file implements a manager for handling update operations with a cap on the number of update managers, merging older entries into versioned buckets to limit the number of concurrent managers.

classes.name: capManagersManager
classes.description: A manager that caps the number of update managers by merging older entries into versioned buckets.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the managed object, then caps the number of update managers.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies changes to the managed object without capping.

methods.name: capUpdateManagers
methods.description: Merges oldest update entries into versioned buckets to limit the number of update managers.
